Record Class OfferTileState

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
it.polimi.ingsw.am23.model.state.OfferTileState
Record Components:
positionIndex - 0-based position of the tile on the board
tileId - letter identifying the tile
occupiedByPlayerId - id of the player currently placed on the tile, or null
minPlayers - minimum number of players for which this tile is in play
topDrawCount - number of cards drawable from the top row
bottomDrawCount - number of cards drawable from the bottom row
foodReward - food reward granted upon resolution
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public record OfferTileState(int positionIndex, char tileId, String occupiedByPlayerId, int minPlayers, int topDrawCount, int bottomDrawCount, int foodReward) extends Record implements Serializable
Immutable snapshot of an offer tile. Carries the tile identifier, the player currently occupying it (if any) and the draw/reward configuration.
